Q3 Planning Sync Summary

Product / Engineering / Ops sync, 2026-08-27. Attendees: Priya (PM), Marcus (Eng lead), Jenna (Ops), Dan (Design), Sara (VP Product).

Task

Summarize the meeting transcript as bullet points covering the key decisions and points, and the next steps / action items.

Key decisions and points

  • Goal: Lock Q3 scope by Friday; Sara takes it to exec review Monday.
  • Reconciliation revamp (Q3 anchor):
    • Current engine fails on multi-currency batches: 3 incidents this quarter, reconciliation support tickets up 40% QoQ.
    • Rewrite scoped at ~6 engineer-weeks, including FX rounding module migration, plus 2 weeks of Karim (platform) for ledger integration.
    • Vendors rejected: Recur ($180K/yr) and LedgerFlow ($140K/yr, lacks jurisdiction-specific tax codes); both need ~3 weeks of integration anyway.
    • Decision: Build in-house.
  • Mobile receipt capture:
    • Flows done; prototype tested with 6 users. Feedback: wanted bulk-select and a more prominent OCR confidence indicator.
    • Bulk-select would add ~1 sprint, and eng is already stretched.
    • Decision: Ship v1 without bulk-select; note it on the roadmap as a fast-follow.
  • Vendor payout SLA (48h from invoice approval):
    • Current p95 is 71h. Bottlenecks: manual approval routing (ops) and 12h ACH batching window (eng).
    • Plan to hit 48h p95 by mid-Q3: cut batching window to 4h and add a second west-coast approver.
    • Cost: more ACH files and monitoring, about half a sprint of eng plus SRE sign-off.
    • Decision: Do a trade-off analysis first. If SRE says the monitoring load is manageable, proceed; otherwise consider intermediate targets.
  • Other items:
    • Audit-log retention update pushed to Q4 (confirmed with Legal).
    • Internal admin-tool refresh stays with the intern crew, unchanged.
    • HR flagged a spike in bug-bash burnout on engineering; a rotating on-call proposal was requested.
